ordered_diagnoses: Lipomatous hypertrophy of the interatrial septum

s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive dyspnea on exertion with significant decreases in blood pressure post-exercise
salient_findings: Rapid dyspnea within 45 seconds of exercise initiation
Decreases in systolic and diastolic blood pressure post-exercise
Well-defined mass within the lower SVC with extension to the interatrial septum
key_facts: 66-year-old female with history of epilepsy, thyroid cancer, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and obstructive sleep apnea
Progressively worsening dyspnea on exertion over 9 months
No associated lower extremity edema, orthopnea, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, chest pain, palpitations, dizziness, or lightheadedness
Lifetime nonsmoker
Normal left ventricular ejection fraction of 60% to 65%
Lipomatous hypertrophy of the interatrial septum present
Normal pulmonary function tests
SVC peak flow velocity: 74 cm/s cephalad to mass, 124 cm/s caudal to mass
Narrowing of the SVC and decreased blood flow through the site of compression

shortlist: Lipomatous hypertrophy of the interatrial septum

shortlist.label: SVC syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: SVC narrowing and decreased blood flow through the site of compression

shortlist.label: Lipomatous hypertrophy of the interatrial septum
Cardiac lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass within the lower SVC with extension to the interatrial septum

shortlist.label: Primary cardiac lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the thoracic cavity and patient's symptoms

raw.rationale: The patient's progressively worsening dyspnea on exertion and significant decreases in systolic and diastolic blood pressure after exercise, combined with imaging findings of a well-defined mass within the lower SVC with extension to the interatrial septum and narrowing of the SVC, are consistent with SVC syndrome.

rejected.label: Lipomatous hypertrophy of the interatrial septum
rejected.why: While present, it does not explain the patient's symptoms or the mass in the SVC.

rejected.label: Cardiac lipoma
rejected.why: The mass in the SVC is not typical of a cardiac lipoma, and the patient's symptoms are more consistent with SVC syndrome.

rejected.label: Thyroid cancer metastasis
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of metastasis, and the mass in the SVC is not typical of a thyroid cancer metastasis.

rejected.label: Primary cardiac lymphoma
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of lymphoma, and the patient's symptoms and imaging findings are more consistent with SVC syndrome.
